• Mama Mia! (hybrid tea, Fryer, 2006)
• Mamma Mia! (hybrid tea, Fryer, 2006)
rows.Bloom: Coral, pink shading. Strong fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, well-branched. Glossy foliage.

Height: 33" (85cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders or garden. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
